newsitem.title: ITALY: Mafia suspect hangs himself in Sicilian prison.
newsitem.headline: Mafia suspect hangs himself in Sicilian prison.

text.p: A reputed Mafia member charged in the killing of a star anti-Mafia judge has hanged himself in prison, jail officials said on Monday.
Giuseppe Biondo, 39, was the second person charged in connection with the 1992 car bombing of judge Paolo Borsellino and five bodyguards to commit suicide in jail this month.
Biondo, who was arrested on November 12, hanged himself in his cell with a sheet on Sunday, the officials said.
He was suspected of preparing the remote control device which set off the car bomb which killed Borsellino.
Giacomo Giuseppe Gambino, 55, hanged himself in his cell in Milan's San Vittore jail on December 1.
Gambino, described as a lieutenant of Mafia superboss Salvatore "Toto" Riina, had also been charged in the Borsellino bombing as well as other Mafia cases.
